p.src: 1  I lift up my eyes to you, you who sit in the heavens.

en: I lift up my eyes to you, you who sit in the heavens.
u.src: 1  I lift up my eyes to you, you who sit in the heavens.

p.src: 2  Behold, as the eyes of servants look to the hand of their master, as the eyes of a maid to the hand of her mistress, so our eyes look to the LORD, our God, until he has mercy on us.

ja: に向かい、 女のしもべの
たちをあわれんでくださるまで。
en: Behold, as the eyes of servants look to the hand of their master, as the eyes of a maid to the hand of her mistress, so our eyes look to the LORD, our God, until he has mercy on us.
u.src: 2  Behold, as the eyes of servants look to the hand of their master, as the eyes of a maid to the hand of her mistress, so our eyes look to the LORD, our God, until he has mercy on us.

p.src: 3  Have mercy on us, LORD, have mercy on us, for we have endured much contempt.

ja: たちをあわれんでください。あわれんでください。
たちはあまりにも多くの
en: Have mercy on us, LORD, have mercy on us, for we have endured much contempt.
u.src: 3  Have mercy on us, LORD, have mercy on us, for we have endured much contempt.

p.src: 4  Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scoffing of those who are at ease, with the contempt of the proud.

en: Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scoffing of those who are at ease, with the contempt of the proud.
u.src: 4  Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scoffing of those who are at ease, with the contempt of the proud.
